source_grid_independence.evidence: Production primitive accepts only op, x, y, color; source contains no grid, neighbor, object, occupancy, foreground-count, or global-state read terms.

claim_boundary.established: Semantic order distinguishability and heldout-vs-train non-overlap are established over the exact whole-grid semantic domain only when whole_grid_exhaustiveness_claim is true; otherwise they are established only over the deterministic single-cell branch-complete domain.
claim_boundary.not_established: This audit does not validate model training, checkpoint quality, ARC generalization, or any future R5A/R5B design.

collision_witness_summary.note: Train/dev and visible/sealed share the same visible program IDs, so same-program fingerprint overlaps are expected bookkeeping overlaps, not semantic aliasing between distinct programs.

K.semantic: if current x <= 3 and current y <= 3 and c in 1..4 then c->c+4

L.semantic: if current x <= 3 and c in 1..4 then c->c+4

semantic_behavior: color transition as a function of current coordinate and color
grammar_inventory.sequence_notation: A->B means apply A first, then B

probe_domain_description.domain: all independent cell states (x,y,color) with x,y in 0..6 and color in 0..8
probe_domain_description.fallback_if_lift_invalid: If the cellwise lift gate fails, this same 441-state set is only a deterministic single-cell / branch-complete probe domain.
probe_domain_description.why_exhaustive: Whole-grid exhaustiveness is claimed only if cellwise_lift_validity.cellwise_lift_valid is true. The gate verifies total in-bounds primitive maps, foreground coordinate bijections, no hidden grid-state reads in the production primitive, and deterministic multi-cell production agreement.
